detail.longDescription: Managing Docker Compose stacks shouldn't require bloated enterprise dashboards or clunky CLI gymnastics. getarcaneapp/arcane is trending on GitHub—a clean, self-hosted container management UI built in Go and SvelteKit: • Visual Docker & Compose stack management • GitOps project syncs and automated update queues • Fast, lightweight Go backend with a responsive web interface https:// github.com/getarcaneapp/arcane # OpenSource # Docker # SelfHosted # GoLang # Linux # DevOps # GitHub
